title: Office MCP
description: Connect an MCP client to your office agents with a personal API token.

sections.title: The MCP endpoint
paragraphs: Bureau exposes an MCP server at POST /mcp. Point any MCP client that supports HTTP transport and bearer authentication at it, using a personal API token. Other token types are refused with 401.

sections.title: Tools
paragraphs: The tools mirror the HTTP API and respect the same room access as the token’s owner.
